memory.scope: Godot process lifetime, including cold loads and warm-up; helper process excluded

scope.actions: Every M01-M07 spec.solution action; begin_action+refresh and every advance_settle(4)+refresh measured; no fast-forward
scope.driver: Explicit tick + exactly one WorldView.refresh per drawn frame; automatic WorldView._process disabled
scope.excluded: Scene/theme cold setup, warm-up, report serialization, and read-only memory helper are outside frame timing; process lifetime memory peak still includes cold setup
scope.fps_method: N+1 real post-draw timestamps delimit N=120 intervals; FPS=120e6/(t120-t0); no tolerance
scope.mode_meaning: Normal Boot frame cap 64 (animation clock 60 Hz); vsync unchanged; raw wall-clock FPS retained with strict >=60 gate
scope.renderer: Actual WorldView and real SDK material render textures, 320x180; HUD/UI excluded
scope.theme_frames: 30 warm-up frames excluded, then all 120 increasing-tick frames retained per theme; actual wall time includes draw waits
scope.undo: Every completed action restored from its real snapshot; separate GD 100ms undo gate
scope.worker_policy: One live SDK world, threads=1, worlds disposed serially; no additional simulation workers
